title: Networking Behind the Scenes: Institutional Cross-Industry Holdings and Corporate Loan Markets
authors: Jie He; Lantian Liang; Hui Wang; Han Xia
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 65 merger events (merger_institution) 1990s-2010s in Table_4 Data.dta, but units are re-used across cohorts, so there is no unit-level adoption date.
eligible_reason: No staggered unit-level adoption design. (i) The baseline evidence (Tables 2, 3, 6, 9) is loan-level OLS of the all-in-drawn spread on holdbank, a loan-level 0/1 indicator that the borrower and a lending bank share an institutional cross-holder, with industry FE (xtset industry), year and lead-lender FE and many time-varying firm and loan controls; holdbank is a deal attribute, not an absorbing adoption. (ii) The quasi-experiment (Tables 4, 5, 8; Figure 2) is a stacked merger-cohort DiD: each of 65 financial-institution mergers forms a cohort; regressions include treat, post (defined relative to each merger date for treated and control loans) and treat_post, with merger x industry (or merger x industry x year, merger x borrower) FE, year FE and lead-lender FE. 25 of the 35 treated industries are treated by more than one merger and 34 of 56 industries serve as both treated and control across cohorts. Same structure as mnsc.2021.4098 (stacked merger cohorts, coded design false). Even Table 4 column 1 (no firm/loan controls) carries the post main effect for controls, lead-lender FE and merger-industry FE.
design_notes: 0_All_analysis.do generates all tables from analysis-ready .dta files. Table 4 (Table_4 Data.dta, 2,969 loans, 1,697 merger-borrower pairs): xtivreg2 allindrawn_w treat_post treat post i.leadlender i.year, fe (merger_industry) cluster(industry year); cols 2-5 add ~22 firm/loan controls and vary the FE (merger_institution, merger_industry_year, merger_borrower). Table 5: same on a propensity-score-matched sample. Figure 2: event-time interactions treat x year_-2..+2 with controls. Table 8 (Table_8 Data.dta): firm-bank pair loanratio around 62 mergers, balanced 2x2 per pair (597 obs per treat x post cell), merger FE or merger-industry FE. Table 7: institution-loan placebo with mgrno FE.
estimators_reported: stacked_merger_cohort_did (treat, post, treat_post; merger x industry FE)
